name: Maths Wizard & Spelling Genius - Uttarakhand
briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and English by organizing competitions at the school, block, district, and state levels, and encouraging them through rewards.
descriptionMd: The scheme “Maths Wizard & Spelling Genius” is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and English by organizing competitions at the school, block, district, and state levels, and by encouraging students through rewards.
benefitsMd: Under this scheme, to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and English, the Government of India organized the “Maths Wizard” and “Spelling Genius” competitions at the school, block, district, and state levels under AWP-B for the year 2023-24, wherein participating students were encouraged through rewards.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a Class 5 student of a government school in Uttarakhand.
applicationMd: The selection of beneficiaries for first, second, and third positions is done through school, block, district, and state-level competitions.
